turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: At night my brain just won't switch off. Work, money, everything.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That racing mind is hard. Would you try writing your worries down before bed, or a slow breathing exercise once you're lying down?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me eight seconds, I want to think about it. Then ask again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, the busy brain. Which one feels like you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Breathing. I'm too tired to write anything.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Breathe in for four, hold for a moment, out for six. Repeat a few rounds slowly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I just found a flea on my cat. Do I need to panic?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No panic needed, but it's worth acting now. Where there's one flea there are usually more.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Get a vet recommended spot on treatment for cats. Never use a dog one, some of them are really toxic to cats.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh wow, I didn't know that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's an important one. Treat every pet in the house, not just her.
